long_biography.plain_text:
Laundry entrepreneur Steve Breitman won an early customer’s loyalty by paying more rent than their agreement required. After two apartment laundry rooms proved profitable, he doubled his payment to the landlord as a gesture of thanks. The owner responded with further contracts and introductions to other property owners, helping him expand through referrals.

Breitman linked the length of laundry leases to equipment costs and expected collections. Where an agreement also included improvements to the room, such as new flooring or lighting, he favoured a longer term. He also recognised that building owners renegotiated contracts to improve residents’ facilities as well as their rental income.
